about:
Clore Automotive, LLC is based in Overland Park, Kansas. The company was founded in 2001, building on an over 50-year heritage in the automotive equipment aftermarket. No founders are named and ownership structure is not disclosed.

The company designs, develops, and manufactures a range of automotive service equipment under brands such as Booster PAC, Jump-N-Carry, SOLAR, CHARGE IT!, and Light-N-Carry. Its product lineup includes jump starters, battery chargers, battery testers, battery maintainers, and work lights for both professional technicians and consumers. No facility size or headcount figures are disclosed.

Clore serves the automotive aftermarket, targeting professional service facilities and individual consumers. Its equipment is used by technicians in repair shops, dealerships, and fleet maintenance operations, as well as by DIY vehicle owners.

The company emphasizes durability and longevity, stating that its products are built to exceed the rigorous demands of professional technicians. It also highlights a technical service team with hands-on industry experience and a commitment to continuous innovation in jump starter battery technology and charging solutions.
